description: This file defines custom wrapper classes around PyTorch's nn.LSTM module, including a renamed version, and variants that handle sequences with or without explicit sequence length information.

classes.name: LstmFlatteningResult
classes.description: A subclass of nn.LSTM that overrides the forward method, returning output, hidden state, and cell state.

classes.name: LstmFlatteningResultWithSeqLength
classes.description: A wrapper around nn.LSTM to handle inputs with explicit sequence length information, encapsulating the underlying LSTM as an inner model.

classes.name: LstmFlatteningResultWithoutSeqLength
classes.description: A wrapper around nn.LSTM for inputs without explicit sequence length, similar to the previous class but with a different forward signature.

methods.name: forward(self, input, *fargs, **fkwargs)
methods.description: Overridden forward method in LstmFlatteningResult that returns output, hidden, and cell states.

methods.name: __init__(self, input_size, hidden_size, layers, bidirect, dropout, batch_first)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the inner LSTM model with specified parameters.

methods.name: forward(self, input, hx=None)
methods.description: Forward method in both wrapper classes that processes input through the inner model and returns output, hidden, and cell states.
